WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_average
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') as rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')
),
status_with_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.rfistat,
    ss.status_avg_modindex,
    oa.overall_average,
    ss.status_avg_modindex - oa.overall_average as above_average
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ss.status_avg_modindex > oa.overall_average
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg_modindex) as mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM status_with_overall
)
SELECT 
  swo.rfistat,
  swo.status_avg_modindex,
  swo.above_average,
  swo.status_avg_modindex - mq.mean_qualifying_avg
FROM status_with_overall swo
CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq
ORDER BY swo.status_avg_modindex DESC;
